class_wire.description: Model classes whose wire form is not `{"$class", ...toJSON()}`. Each maps a wire field to the getter (dotted path) it is read from. `extra`: written beside the toJSON fields when defined and left in the data fromData reads. `context`: written beside the toJSON fields when defined, and passed to the constructor after the data. `fields`: replace the toJSON fields; the constructor takes them in this order. `array`: toJSON is an array, carried under this field.

surface_differences.description: Numeric arguments of the typed C++ API convert under C++ rules before any check runs (-1 to uint32_t, 63.7 to int), so a value TS rejects can arrive in range. The JSON surfaces receive doubles and validate them as TS does.
An unknown keyword argument is a TypeError raised by Python itself; TS ignores unknown option keys.

A field holding an explicit undefined is omitted on the wire, so a check that tells it apart from an absent field sees it absent. The `'numerator' in data` test of ts/src/core/meter/index.ts (MeterLike) is the documented case; a check that rejects an explicit undefined (countermelody weights) accepts the omitted field instead. That test is listed in ts_only_units.
JSON holds no cycle: an argument that contains itself crosses with each repeat cut to an empty object or array. Where TS reports the cycle, the facade reports what the cut value fails.
Each call receives a fresh copy of its arguments, so TS's per-object caches (the tempo-map and meter WeakMaps) never see a repeat; results are unchanged, only the saving is lost.
The C++ core keeps no module-level memo of pure results (TS remembers joint scale spellings), so a repeated question is worked out again; results are unchanged, only the saving is lost.
A result is a fresh decoded value per call. Identity survives only for `$id` results of handle getters (and the objects they share), handles by id, and a hybrid returned unchanged from an argument.

ts_only_units.reason: Times the WeakMap cache of one tempo-map object; each call over the wire receives a fresh copy (identity-cache).

ts_only_units.reason: Times the TS memo of joint scale spellings, which the C++ core does not keep (module-memo).

file_map_exceptions.reason: grid.ts and reference/profile.ts import it from form/internal.ts; C++ places it with the grid, and the form and reference modules use it from there.
deepFreeze makes the vocabulary tables immutable at runtime; in C++ the generated tables are const values, so the file has no counterpart.
The field-name reader of ProfileWeightOverrides is an internal header so the op adapter that checks a caller's overrides can share it with safety.cpp.

identity_exceptions.reason: ArrangementSession#analysis is a handle getter; `$id` keeps the unchanged analysis the same object across update().
Chords an update carries over are tagged `$id` inside ArrangementSession#analysis, so they stay the same objects.
